children.counts: Simplified 2-count movement beats: 1-pass under arm, 2-circle overhead.
children.game_version: A skill challenge using a plastic hoop or paper plate balancing a small beanbag while navigating simple arm passes.

avoid: Using real glass or liquid props
seniors.counts: Slow 4-count sweeps for each phase of the figure-eight pattern.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm trajectories and figure-eight loops while seated firmly in a chair without props or using a lightweight empty hoop.
seniors.standing_version: Execute slow overhead loops and hand passes from a wide, stable standing posture without adding liquid-filled glasses.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and moderate arm range avoiding maximum shoulder extension or extreme wrist twisting.

learning_units.description: Execute the Basic 8 arm trajectory passing under the armpit and overhead without dropping prop balance.
Perform the overhead Change transfer smoothly between main and auxiliary hands.

prerequisites.description: Good wrist flexibility, upper body coordination, balance, and knowledge of Cypriot footwork.

social_formats.description: Solo competitive dancer accompanied by an assistant placing props.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Continuous twisting wrist movements, full arm extensions overhead, sweeping figure-eight patterns, and behind-the-back hand transfers.
movement_profile.footwork: Traditional Cypriot rhythmic footwork maintaining spatial orientation while supporting continuous arm rotations.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo dancer in place or spinning on axis, requiring enough clear space for arm-length sieve arcs.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Torso leans and rotates fluidly in coordination with arm movements to allow clearance under armpits.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Ranging from standing upright to deep single-knee kneeling positions; no jumps described.
movement_profile.partnering: Solo performance, assisted by a helper who places wine glasses into the sieve.
movement_profile.posture: Flexible torso with controlled forward leaning to facilitate armpit passes and overhead sweeps.

signature_moves.description: A figure-eight pattern sweeping under the armpit and forming a large arc over the head.
signature_moves.name: The 8

signature_moves.description: A reverse figure-eight starting overhead and folding under the armpit.
signature_moves.name: The Reverse 8

signature_moves.description: An overhead hand transfer executed at the apex of the Basic 8 movement.
signature_moves.name: The Change

signature_moves.description: A behind-the-back hand transfer combined with a body spin during a Reverse 8.
signature_moves.name: The Reverse Change

signature_moves.description: A 270-degree arm extension followed by a tight wrist twist and immediate reversal.
signature_moves.name: Windmill

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Fluid, continuous, and swift without abrupt stops.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid stopping arm movement suddenly, abrupt wrist jerks, or letting glasses touch the top rim of the sieve.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Continuous rhythmic accompaniment suited for smooth, continuous hand trajectories.

basic_steps: Grip the top perimeter of the sieve with four fingers inside and the thumb on the outside.
Execute the Basic 8 by leaning forward, twisting the wrist inward to pass the sieve under the armpit, and extending upward into a high overhead arc.
Execute the Reverse 8 by raising the arm in a broad lateral circle overhead, then folding the elbow inward to pass under the armpit.
Perform the Change by grabbing the sieve overhead with the opposite hand at the peak of the 8 arc, continuing directly into a Reverse 8.
Perform the Reverse Change by sweeping the sieve behind the back during a torso spin and transferring hands behind the body.
teaching.formation: Solo performance, often accompanied by an assistant who places or adjusts the glasses.
teaching.level_notes: Requires high manual control, wrist flexibility, continuous fluid movement, and stamina. Advanced variations involve kneeling or multi-glass stacking.
teaching.rhythm: Steady rhythmic meter aligned with traditional Cypriot folk dance.
